source: Qi et al. (2023), Applied Thermal Engineering 227, 120361
method: Manual marker-center readings of Figure 5, PDF page 5 rendered at scale 4 (2382 x 3175 pixels). Coordinates below are relative to crop [480,190,1940,780]. Linear axes. Rounded temperatures pair corresponding markers between panels; do not interpret rounding as experimental precision. Merged peak markers use text peak and approximate flow interpolation. Enlarged error-bar illustration excluded.

reading_allowance.meaning: Manual reading allowances, not standard deviations or confidence intervals; peak flow has an additional interpolation allowance of 0.04 mg/s.

points.note: Peak capacity and temperature from section 3.2; flow interpolated visually within merged peak cluster.

diagnostic_note: Radiation Figure 8(b), page 6, and outlet temperature Figure A2, page 9, are AUTHOR MODEL outputs, not independent measurements. Figure 8 caption states axial conduction below 2 mW. They are used only to diagnose model discrepancy. Cold branch below 100 K has documented wet-return limitations in the author's model.
